skill2: Activates if Shopping is at max stacks when Full Burst ends. (max-stack precondition on the Burst Gauge filling speed rider is not gated — no maxStacks-reached block gate exists in the schema)
burst: Attract: Taunts all enemies for 5 sec.

caveats: ⚑ skill2 Shopping stack trigger: kit says 'when an ally uses a Burst Skill' — modeled as burstCast on ANY ally (the engine's burstCast trigger is owner-cast-keyed). If the engine keys burstCast to the OWNER only, this UNDER-fires by ~3-4x per rotation; a stageEnter-per-stage triple-block would over/under-fire differently. Unmeasured.

⚑ skill2 max-stacks precondition on the Burst Gauge rider is NOT gated: with 3 burst casts per rotation the 4-stack cap (20s duration) is reached during rotation 2 and holds thereafter, so the rider is modeled as always-on from the first fullBurstEnd. This OVER-credits the first ~1-2 rotations' gauge.

⚑ Burst Gauge filling speed ▲7.9% mapped to burstGenPct (the unit's own gauge contribution scaler) applied to all allies. Whether the engine's burstGenPct is per-unit-contribution or a global fill-rate scaler determines whether this is faithful.

defPct is documented inert in v1 (self DEF does not affect own damage). Both DEF lines are kept for kit completeness / a future consumer, per the HARD RULE that DEF/HP lines are not skippable — they may drive a teammate's DEF-scaling conversion.

The burst heal is modeled as 10 recovery events over 10 sec (ticks:10) so on-recovery consumers (e.g. a Crown-style 'when recovery takes effect' partner) stay refreshed; no HP amount is modeled. The 50.47%-of-attack-damage magnitude is not representable.
Taunt is skipped: the v1 boss deals no damage and there is no aggro model, so a taunt has no damage-relevant channel.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Rupee: Winter Shopper is an AR/Electric/Defender Burst I. Her kit carries NO damage effects at all — it is entirely DEF, heal/taunt, reload speed, burst-gauge, and a Burst-Stage-1 re-entry. The two damage-relevant channels are (a) burst Reload Speed ▲63.17%/10s to all allies, which is a weapon-state modifier and therefore IS damage (it gates shots fired — HARD RULE 6), and (b) the reenterStage:1 rotation effect, which lets a second Burst I unit also cast at stage 1 and can materially change the rotation. The Shopping stack and Burst Gauge filling speed lines feed rotation via gauge rate. Both DEF lines (S1 last-bullet 19.02%/5s, S2 Shopping 1.33%×4/20s) are modeled as defPct even though defPct is inert in v1 — DEF lines are never auto-skipped (tandem/cross-unit rule), and dropping them would erase the kit from the file. All three slots authored; skipped lines are listed verbatim in `unmodeled`.

audit.kitLine: Activates when the last bullet hits
audit.effectOrReason: trigger lastBullet — literal 'when the last bullet hits the target' = the per-magazine last-bullet trigger (trigger-identity rule). NOT interval, NOT shotFired.
target {kind:'allies'} — 'all allies' includes self (no 'except self' clause), so excludeSelf is omitted.

buff defPct 19.02, durationSec 5. Wall-clock seconds (explicit 'for 5 sec', not rounds). defPct is engine-inert in v1 but is NOT skippable per the DEF/HP/lifesteal hard rule — kept for kit completeness and any future DEF-scaling consumer.

audit.kitLine: Activates when an ally uses a Burst
audit.effectOrReason: trigger burstCast. ⛑ Kit says 'an ALLY uses a Burst Skill' — an ANY-ally-cast trigger, which fires ~3x per rotation (B1+B2+B3), not once. The schema's burstCast is documented as 'when the OWNER casts their burst'. Modeled as burstCast as the nearest primitive; flagged as the top divergence risk.
buff defPct 1.33 — the per-stack magnitude (kit states the PER-STACK value, with the cap expressed separately as maxStacks).
maxStacks 4, durationSec 20 on the same buff. Wall-clock seconds. Named status 'Shopping' is the stack pool that the second S2 block's precondition reads.

audit.kitLine: Activates if Shopping is at max
audit.effectOrReason: The MAX-STACKS PRECONDITION is not modeled: there is no block gate for 'this unit's own named buff is at max stacks' (resourceGate reads a declared resource pool, not a buff's stack count; requiresTargetStatus is boss-scoped). Modeled as ungated, which over-credits early rotations before 4 stacks accrue. Verbatim in unmodeled.skill2.
trigger fullBurstEnd — literal match to the schema's fullBurstEnd kind.

buff burstGenPct 7.9, durationSec 5, target allies. ⛑ burstGenPct is documented as 'scales the unit's burst gauge contribution'; a team-wide gauge-fill-speed line is the closest available stat. Rotation-relevant (it can shift full-burst counts), so it is NOT skippable.

No taunt/aggro primitive in the schema and no damage channel for it — the v1 boss deals no damage and targeting is unmodeled, so a taunt is provably damage-inert at scope lock. Verbatim in unmodeled.burst.

audit.kitLine: Recovers 50.47% of atk dmg as HP
audit.effectOrReason: heal {ticks:10, intervalSec:1} on self — 'over 10 sec' modeled as 10 one-per-second recovery events so any teammate's 'when recovery takes effect' consumer stays refreshed (tandem rule: heal lines are never skipped on isolation). No HP pool is modeled, so the 50.47% magnitude is unrepresentable and is not encoded anywhere.
target {kind:'allies'} on the second burst block (the kit's second header re-scopes from self to all allies).

buff reloadSpeedPct 63.17, durationSec 10, target allies. This is a WEAPON-STATE modifier and therefore IS damage (HARD RULE 6) — it raises shots fired for every ally in the window. The single largest damage-relevant line in the kit.

reenterStage {stage:1} — the rotation stays at stage 1 so ANOTHER eligible Burst I unit may also cast. Placed on the self-targeted block (a rotation-state effect, not a per-ally grant). Rotation-material: it can change full-burst counts.

flags.estimate: burstCast (owner-keyed) as the encoded primitive; the kit's true semantics are ANY-ally-burst-cast, ~3 fires per rotation vs 1
flags.reasoning: Kit text is literally 'Activates when an ALLY uses a Burst Skill' — the trigger-identity failure mode #3 in reverse: this is broader than burst-cast, not narrower. types.ts documents burstCast as 'when the OWNER casts their burst'. If the engine fires it owner-only, Shopping accrues 1 stack/rotation and takes 4 rotations to cap instead of reaching 4 within rotation 2. The alternative encodings — three stageEnter blocks (stage 1/2/3) or a single fullBurstEnter — each mis-time differently. Since defPct is inert in v1 the DAMAGE consequence is zero today, but the stack count feeds the max-stacks precondition on the gauge rider, which IS rotation-relevant.
flags.recipe: Read the engine's burstCast dispatch: does it fire per-owner-cast or per-any-cast? If owner-only, split into three stageEnter{stage:1|2|3} blocks (a Burst I unit's own cast is already covered by stage 1) and re-check that Shopping caps by the second rotation. Cross-check against any other roster unit whose kit says 'when an ally uses a Burst Skill'.

flags.estimate: ungated — rider fires on EVERY fullBurstEnd from the first one; true behavior gates it to fullBurstEnd events where Shopping is at 4 stacks
flags.reasoning: No schema primitive gates a block on the owner's own named buff being at max stacks. The available gates (resourceGate / requiresTargetStatus / fbGate / everyN) do not read a buff's stack count. Under the any-ally-burst reading, 3 stacks accrue per rotation with a 20s duration, so 4 stacks are reached partway through rotation 2 and hold for the rest of a 180s fight — meaning the ungated model over-credits roughly the first 1-2 full-burst-end events out of ~8-12. Small but non-zero on gauge.
flags.recipe: Either (a) declare a 'shopping' resource pool with the stack trigger adding delta:1 (clamped max 4) and gate the rider with resourceGate {name:'shopping', min:4} — but resource pools have no time decay, so the 20s expiry is lost; or (b) approximate with everyN/everyNOffset to skip the first N fullBurstEnd events once the real ramp is measured. Measure by counting full bursts in a recording with and without the rider active.

flags.reasoning: 'Burst Gauge filling speed ▲' is a team-wide gauge-rate line, but burstGenPct is documented as scaling 'the unit's burst gauge contribution'. If the engine multiplies each holder's own per-shot gauge, applying it to all allies is faithful; if it is a caster-scoped global, applying it 5x would 5x-count. Magnitude is kit-literal (7.9), so only the SCOPE is uncertain, not the number.
flags.recipe: Grep sim.ts for the burstGenPct consumer: confirm it multiplies the HOLDER's own gauge contribution per shot. If so, allies-scope is correct as written. Validate end-to-end by full-burst count on a recorded fight with this unit present vs a sim run with the rider stripped.

flags.estimate: ticks: 10, intervalSec: 1 (10 recovery events over the stated 10 sec)
flags.reasoning: Kit says 'Recovers 50.47% of attack damage as HP OVER 10 sec' — a heal-over-time, not an instant. types.ts explicitly documents the HoT pattern as ticks:N with intervalSec default 1. The tick COUNT is a convention (the kit does not state a per-second cadence, only a total window), and it matters only to on-recovery consumers' refresh cadence, which are the sole reason this effect exists in the model at all (no HP pool in v1).
flags.recipe: Only matters when this unit is teamed with an on-recovery consumer (e.g. a Crown-style 'when recovery takes effect' kit). Record such a team and count the consumer's proc events across the 10s window: 10 procs confirms 1/sec, 1 proc means it is an instant-total heal and ticks should drop to 1.

flags.estimate: engine defaults from the datamine (ammo 60, reloadFrames 81) — not overridden here
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⛑ field 1: the datamined cadence tuple (rate_of_fire, reloadFrames) is a known-unreliable source. This unit's ONLY damage-relevant burst line is Reload Speed ▲ 63.17%, whose entire effect is mediated through reloadFrames — so an unreliable reloadFrames propagates directly into the one number this kit contributes to the board. Not encoded as an override field (nothing to override without a measurement), but load-bearing.
flags.recipe: Frame-count her reload animation in a focus recording (last-bullet frame → first-shot-of-next-magazine frame), unbuffed, then again inside her own burst window, and check the ratio against 1/(1+0.6317).

flags.reasoning: Per the methodology, noFb is measured-only and defaults OFF. This kit carries NO damage effects whatsoever — no flatDamage, dot, hitRepeat, or storedHit — so noFb has no carrier to attach to and the question is vacuous for this unit. Recorded here only to show the ALWAYS-⛑ checklist item was evaluated, not silently dropped.
